projects.title: Detection of Mango Plant Diseases Based on Leaf Images Using the YOLO11 Algorithm on Android
projects.description: This project aims to assist farmers in detecting early-stage mango leaf diseases through a mobile Android application powered by YOLO11n.
insights: Preprocessed 1,405 Harum Manis mango leaf images using Roboflow for manual bounding box annotation and resizing (640x640) across three classes: Anthracnose (525), Sooty Mould (656), and Healthy (224).

Split the dataset into 70% training, 15% validation, and 15% testing sets to train and evaluate the YOLO11n model across 4 distinct hyperparameter scenarios (varying batch sizes 16/24, SGD/Adam optimizers, 50 epochs, learning rate 0.01, and patience 10).
projects.outcome: Successfully grouped 2,406 news articles into 3 optimal clusters with a Silhouette Score of 0.2718, representing distinct categories: Politics, Technology, and General News.

projects.title: Kitchen Equipment Sales Performance Dashboard
projects.description: This project aims to transform raw sales transaction data into an interactive Looker Studio dashboard to help management monitor sales revenue, assess business performance accurately, and drive data-informed decision-making.
insights: Cleaned and structured raw sales transaction data (handling missing values, formatting date structures, and standardizing product/city names).
Calculated key sales metrics, including Total Revenue, Total Orders, Order Completion Rate, and revenue breakdowns by product, category, and city.
Designed and developed an interactive dashboard in Looker Studio using trend lines, doughnut charts, and bar graphs to display sales distribution clearly.
projects.outcome: Successfully built and deployed an interactive Business Intelligence dashboard in Looker Studio to streamline business performance monitoring and track key sales KPIs in real time.

projects.title: Automated News Category Clustering Using K-Means algorithm
projects.description: This project aims to automatically group news articles based on topic similarity using the K-Means Clustering algorithm.
insights: Preprocessed 2,406 news articles using tokenization, stopword removal, lemmatization, and entity merging for location (GPE) and organization (ORG) names.
Integrating TF-IDF with Truncated SVD effectively reduces noise and optimizes computation speed without losing key topic variations.
Evaluating model performance via Silhouette Score provides an objective way to determine the optimal number of distinct clusters.
projects.outcome: Successfully grouped 2,406 news articles into 3 optimal clusters with a Silhouette Score of 0.2718, representing distinct categories: Politics, Technology, and General News.

projects.title: Employee Attendance Management System
projects.description: Developed a web-based employee attendance management system to simplify daily attendance recording and employee attendance monitoring within a company. The system provides two user roles: Admin and Employee, each with different access permissions and functionalities.
insights: Developed CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) functionality for managing employee data and attendance records.
Developed employee attendance features, including clock-in, clock-out, leave requests, and sick leave submissions.
Enabled employees to track attendance records, view attendance history, and monitor attendance statistics.
Provided administrators with employee data management, attendance monitoring, leave management, and attendance report generation.
projects.outcome: Successfully developed a centralized attendance management system that helps administrators manage employee attendance records and enables employees to record and monitor their daily attendance more efficiently.
